# Deepak Jangra — Independent Shopify Developer

> Deepak Jangra is an independent Shopify Plus developer with 9+ years of experience. He builds, rebuilds, and rescues high-performance Shopify stores for DTC merchants, and partners white-label with agencies. Canonical site: https://deepakj.dev. Contact: howdy@deepakj.dev.

## Services

- Custom Shopify and Shopify Plus builds (Liquid, Checkout Extensibility, Hydrogen headless storefronts)
- Performance and Core Web Vitals optimization (sub-2-second loads)
- Store rescue: broken checkouts, overloaded themes, messy app stacks, post-acquisition migrations
- Subscription commerce (Recharge) and retention (Klaviyo lifecycle flows, event tracking)
- AI-codebase rescue: refactoring Cursor/Copilot/v0 prototypes into production apps
- White-label development for agencies under NDA (pilot projects, fractional retainers)

## Working together

- Free store audits and project inquiries via the contact form on any page, or email howdy@deepakj.dev
- Typical engagements: fixed-price builds, 48-hour audits ($1,500–$2,000), agency pilots and retainers
- Process: audit and discovery, staging environment, async agile build, QA and documented handoff
